nodes.label: LMS: Leighton-Micali Hash-Based Structure Signatures (IETF RFC 8554)
nodes.description: Stateful hash-based digital signature algorithm standardized under IETF RFC 8554 and NIST SP 800-208 for post-quantum firmware and boot image verification.

nodes.label: CXL 3.1 Type-2 Heterogeneous Accelerator Device Architecture
nodes.description: Hardware accelerator architecture implementing CXL.io, CXL.cache, and CXL.mem protocols for bi-directional memory sharing between CPU host and device-local memory.

nodes.label: MARBERT Large-Scale Dialectal and Modern Standard Arabic Language Model
nodes.description: Deep bidirectional transformer model pre-trained on a massive corpus of Arabic tweets and text, optimized for dialectal sequence classification and named entity recognition.

nodes.label: ISO/IEC 39075 Information Technology — Database Languages — GQL
nodes.description: International standard graph query language for property graphs providing declarative pattern matching, path queries, and graph transformation capabilities.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS FastSV Connected Components Decomposition Algorithm
nodes.description: Parallel connected components algorithm implemented via sparse matrix-vector operations and vector-masking based on the FastSV algorithm in GraphBLAS.
